name: dsh-plugin-background
description: Web GUI background plugin: per-area image groups with per-image display and rendering config (fill/fit/stretch/tile/center/custom + position, scale, size, repeat, rotation, radius, opacity, blur), slideshow playback, and local file/folder picking stored as IndexedDB blobs (no base64 packing); own settings section. TypeScript sources, esbuild-built bundle.
